_comment: ignoreCommand: exit 0 = skip the build, exit 1 = build. Build only when a commit touches something other than the two live data files. dashboard/{status,sft}.json are fetched at runtime straight from raw.githubusercontent (see index.html's RAW_BASE), so a data commit never needs a deploy. A second clause used to compare the live shell against the repo's index.html as a 'shell changed but never deployed' safety net -- it deadlocked on 2026-08-21: any undeployed shell change makes that comparison fail forever, so every one of the daemon's ~2-minute data pushes started a build, and a ~4-minute build was always superseded before it finished. The net could never fire because it fired on everything.
ignoreCommand: git diff --name-only HEAD^ HEAD | grep -qvE '^dashboard/(status|sft)[.]json$' && exit 1; exit 0
